core_obligations: Statement (lines 6009-6017): for a proper curve X over k with H^0(X, O_X) = k and at-worst-nodal singularities, a rational tail C of X, and any field extension K/k, the base change C_K is a finite disjoint union of rational tails of X_K.

Decomposition (proof lines 6019-6026): C cong P^1_{k'}; since k'/k is finite separable, k' tensor_k K = K'_1 x ... x K'_n with each K'_i/K finite separable; setting C_i = P^1_{K'_i} and x_i the inverse image of x gives C_K = disjoint union of the C_i.
Tail property (lines 6026-6029): X_K cap C_i = x_i, the base change of the defining property X cap C = {x}, so each C_i is a rational tail of X_K.
proof_roadmap: Identify the tail with a projective line over the residue field of the node.
Decompose the scalar extension algebra into a product of separable extensions.
Transport the tail property through the base change.

H2: short explicit base-change argument.
